p3ca67e9cb1.notes: Far rooftop lettering of the Prishtina bus station seen through trees; only 'STACIONI' is clearly legible (a branch crosses the T). The rest of the sign is hidden by a road-sign back and a tree trunk; fragments after it look like 'UTO...' but are not transcribed. Query is the station's name inferred from the visible word and the photo's location, not read in full.

pe373096f7c.reason: 'Smoking zone' notice, not a place name

k294550667.notes: Wide view down a paved walkway in Pristina; the small white TERRACE38 panel sits above a row of shop signs at the far end. Distractors: 'Capital / Ria / PAGESAT' money-transfer fascia, 'CONA SPORT' shoe-shop sign, red neon letters, and PAGESAT / Capital Ria boards on the railings in the foreground.

k294559285.notes: Maxi supermarket, Pristina: red MAXI letters (X drawn as a stylised hourglass) on a dark box sign over the entrance; a second large MAXI in raised red letters on the roof is seen edge-on and hard to read.

k295704721.reason: ice-cream/dessert menu and price poster in a window

k295704761.reason: political graffiti/stencil ('KU UKSHIN HOTI?') on a wall; the small shop signs are unreadable

k295712015.notes: Round hanging café sign with a tree logo whose trunk forms the D of SONDER, Pristina. Two small tagline lines below the name are unreadable. BEKO logo on the air conditioner is a distractor.

k295713847.reason: taxi and truck branding (Radio Taxi Dallas); no fixed sign as target

k296842777.reason: back of a football shirt (VOKRRI 9) is the subject; shop signs behind are unreadable

k296842797.reason: NEWBORN monument letters covered in graffiti; no legible name

k300876923.notes: Rooftop letters of the Grand Hotel Prishtina seen far away down a street against a white sky; the start ('Gra') is hidden behind the building on the left. Low contrast.

pd6dde1fae8.notes: Outlined black letters engraved on a granite public drinking fountain in Pristina, seen from above at an angle ('Qeshmja' = the fountain). Spelled 'Qeshmja' with Q on the stone (standard Albanian would be Çeshmja).

c87483280.notes: Prizren. Two blue street-name blades on one pole (Albanian/Serbian/Turkish abbreviations rr./ul./sk.), seen from below. Keep the Ç in KAÇINARI. Distractors: brown/green tourist panels in four languages (Parku Nacional 'Prevalla', Muzeu i Lidhjes së Prizrenit / Museum of Prizren League, Shtëpia e Kulturës, Muzeu Arkeologjik), a blue direction sign 'Prishtinë / Pristina Pristine', 'Brezovicë / Brezovica Brezovica', and a '...PARK' board.

c87483297.notes: Prizren, below the fortress. Blue enamel trilingual street plate (Albanian / Serbian Latin / Turkish) with street-register number 337, on a stone gatepost. Red-white hiking waymark above it.

c87483309.notes: Prizren, at night under flash, shot upward. A keep-right regulatory sign in the foreground partly overlaps the lower-left of the frame but not the plate. Different street from the Adem Jashari plate.

c15444014.reason: politically defaced direction sign: the Serbian names are covered with stickers (anti-Serb vandalism), so it is partly illegible protest content

c17030611.notes: Pristina, National Library building. Raised-letter name board on the domed lattice facade, shot from below at an angle. Keep the ë in KOMBËTARE and KOSOVËS.

c25258260.notes: Pristina dental clinic lightbox, near-frontal. Tooth logo at left.

c12056870.notes: Prizren. Small blue street plate on a wall; the name is spelt with Turkish Ş ('PRIŞTINA'), the Albanian spelling is Prishtina. Larger distractors: 'Restaurant SEF... / PR... JELLERA' banner, graffiti 'PE', kiosk with 'KEMI PIJE TE FTOHTA' notice.

c12057027.reason: the only sign is a tiny, blurred street plate ('Rr. Ul. Cad. 201', name not reliably legible at 1600 px); same Prizren 2010 series as c12056870

c24910421.notes: Pristina. Large raised serif letters with a star logo on a grey textured wall, near-frontal.

c134036998.notes: Pristina at night. Two identical illuminated round logos on a pylon, small in the frame; 'viva' is a small green script word above 'Fresh Store' in red-and-yellow script. A cut-off lit sign at the top right and one-way arrow signs are distractors.

c25378173.reason: donor/project boards ('Rehabilitation of the City Park', EU water-pipe replacement project board); project notices rather than a park name sign

c64725463.notes: Pristina. Two blue street blades on one pole: the frontal one is the target (George Bush Boulevard in Albanian spelling); the second blade 'RR. / UL. MARK SOPI' is angled away. A parked car and a mobile-tariff billboard ('Komuniko shumë dhe...', 3G/4G prices) are distractors.
